mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when unemployment exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth with rising unemployment may indicate labor market instability, negatively impacting returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite mixed labor signals.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production in late-cycle expansion signals economic downturn, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite slowing production.

mechanism_narrative: Growing real sales indicate strong demand, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when RSAFS grows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production indicates supply issues, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth paired with rising federal funds may signal tightening, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with GDP growth and rising rates.
